Leila: quick design check — mobile suppression preview is in the latest build: https://redwood-internal/ux/screens/12345 Sam: looks good, but the mute pill tap target feels small on phones. can we expand padding? :iphone: Zack: also accessibility — when you toggle suppression, screen readers don't announce the preview change. suggest aria-live="polite" on the preview container. :accessibility: Maya: copy nit: 'Suppressed' vs 'Muted' — prefer 'Muted' since it's more relatable. 'Muted for 2h' vs 'Suppression window: 2h' Leila: good call. @Zack can you drop a minimal snippet for the aria change? Zack: sure: ```
Preview: channels muted — Slack, PagerDuty (2)
``` Sam: also UX: multiple suppressed channels should show an overflow +N badge instead of a long line. keeps vertical rhythm and avoids truncation. Maya: contrast: the gray label is 3.8:1 with background, below 4.5. bump to darker gray or use token semanticText.warn so it passes 4.5:1. Leila: behavior question — if user mutes a channel in preview only (not saved), do we persist until close or reset instantly? Sam: prefer ephemeral until Save. users expect cancel to revert. Zack: agree, but add toast 'Changes are preview-only — remember to save' for discoverability. maybe a subtle pin indicator on the preview bar. Leila: ok action items: Sam - pad/tap target, Maya - copy + contrast tokens, Zack - aria snippet + toast text, I'll prototype the overflow badge. Thanks! :thumbsup: prod-bot: deploy 2026-03-22T14:12Z — ui/mobile-suppression-preview v1
